title: Picus Offers Singapore-Hosted Security Validation for Local Data Residency
content_md: Picus Security offers a Singapore-hosted deployment of the Picus Platform . It allows organizations to keep customer data in Singapore while continuously validating their attack surfaces, security controls, and exposures.
